_decision.scope: individual player talent only (rankings, league ranks, value vs. contract); NOT team strength (power rankings, roster strength)
_decision.why: In-season player test (8 seasons x 5 checkpoints, leave-one-season-out), on top of the 3-season talent with experience prior: forwards r .634 -> .645, defensemen .621 -> .625, with young players improving ~0.02/60 per year below 27 and older forwards declining ~0.016/60 per year above 27. A player's OWN trend over past seasons added nothing (coef ~0). At the team level, every aging curve made roster/power predictions worse (selection: veterans still on rosters are the good ones), so team strength uses talent without the age adjustment.
